record.context_brief: PDE proof of Kolodziej sup estimate
record.original_question: Give a proof, using PDE techniques, of the a priori estimate in Theorem 3.1: if B is the unit ball in C^n, p > 1, phi is a smooth plurisubharmonic function on B with phi|_{partial B} = 0, and det(phi_{j ar{k}}) = f, then ||phi||_{L^infty(B)} <= C ||f||_{L^p(B)}^{1/n}, where C depends only on n and p.

evidence.quote: Theorem 3.1. Let B be the unit ball of C^n and fix p > 1. If phi is a smooth plurisubharmonic function in B such that phi|_{partial B} = 0, then ||phi||_{L^infty(B)} <= C ||f||_{L^p(B)}^{1/n}, where det(phi_{jk}) = f and C only depends on n, p. Question 18 (Blocki-Kolodziej). Find a proof of the above estimate that relies on PDE techniques.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ denote the open unit ball, and fix a real number $p > 1$. Suppose $\varphi \in C^\infty(\overline{B})$ is a smooth plurisubharmonic function on $B$ with boundary values $\varphi|_{\partial B} = 0$, and let $f \geq 0$ be the function defined by the complex Monge–Ampère equation
$$\det\!\Big(\tfrac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial z_j \, \partial \bar z_k}\Big)_{1 \le j,k \le n} = f \quad \text{on } B.$$
It is known (via pluripotential theory) that there exists a constant $C = C(n,p)$, depending only on $n$ and $p$, such that
$$\|\varphi\|_{L^\infty(B)} \;\le\; C \, \|f\|_{L^p(B)}^{1/n}.$$
Provide a proof of this a priori estimate using purely PDE techniques (for example, maximum principle arguments, auxiliary Monge–Ampère comparison functions, or integral/iteration methods), without recourse to pluripotential theory.
artifact.status_search_result: A PDE proof of Kołodziej's $L^\infty$ estimate for the complex Monge–Ampère equation (covering the full range $p>1$) was obtained by B. Guo, D.H. Phong, and F. Tong in "On $L^\infty$ estimates for complex Monge–Ampère equations" (arXiv:2106.02224, Annals of Mathematics, 2023). Earlier partial PDE proofs were given by Błocki (2011) using the ABP maximum principle but only for $p>2$. The Guo–Phong–Tong work is widely cited as resolving the question of a PDE-based proof.

status_evidence.title: On $L^\infty$ estimates for complex Monge-Ampère equations
status_evidence.snippet: We give a PDE proof of the sharp $L^\infty$ estimates for the complex Monge–Ampère equation which had required pluripotential theory before.
status_evidence.claim: Guo, Phong, and Tong provide a PDE-based proof of Kołodziej's sharp $L^\infty$ estimate for the complex Monge–Ampère equation.

status_evidence.title: On $L^\infty$ estimates for complex Monge-Ampère equations — Annals of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Published in Annals of Mathematics, 2023; gives a PDE proof of the L^infty estimates previously requiring pluripotential theory.
status_evidence.claim: The PDE proof appeared in Annals of Mathematics in 2023, settling the question.

status_evidence.title: Uniform estimates: from Yau to Kołodziej
status_evidence.snippet: Kołodziej (1998) proved the L^infty estimate using pluripotential theory; Guo–Phong–Tong (2023) recovered the estimate by a PDE method.
status_evidence.claim: Survey confirms Guo–Phong–Tong's 2023 PDE proof recovers Kołodziej's estimate.
